comments.why: Musician uses AI to detect AI-generated music.
comments.text: Ben Jordan (from the band The Flashbulb) has a great video about using AI to detect AI music. It's worth a watch. [VIDEO]

comments.author: milesvp
comments.story: Deezer says 44% of songs uploaded to its platform daily are AI-generated
comments.why: Describes spotting AI music via compression artifacts from training data.
comments.text: Not sure what algorithm Deezer is using, but Benn Jordan is a fairly tech savvy musician who talks about ways to id AI generated music by looking for compression artifacts used by the training data. [VIDEO]

comments.author: belthesar
comments.story: AI Generated Music Barred from Bandcamp
comments.why: Benn Jordan discusses harm to musicians from AI impersonation and flooding.
comments.text: Musicians who are being threatened by AI impersonating them, flooding the market with music like theirs, and otherwise actually harmed by this would disagree with you. Benn Jordan speaks at length about it in this video: [VIDEO]
